title: 检测大语言模型幻觉：追踪受损上下文共享的拓扑特征
summary: 本文通过分析注意力图的Forman-Ricci曲率，识别信息瓶颈的拓扑模式，提出一种单次推理的幻觉检测方法，捕捉注意力头的半局部与全局信息流特征。实验表明该方法在多个LLM和基准上优于现有基线，并发现幻觉与自注意力过度依赖、上下文检索扩散及信息过度压缩相关。
summary_en: This work analyzes Forman-Ricci curvature in attention graphs to identify topological patterns of information bottlenecks, proposing a single-pass hallucination detection method capturing semi-local and global information-flow characteristics of attention heads. Experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmarks show consistent improvements over existing baselines, revealing that hallucination is linked to over-reliance on self-attention, diffused context retrieval, and information over-squashing.
